items.title: George "Pops" Foster and Mugsy Spanier Interview, 1957-04-21
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] When were you born, Lindsey? Chicago.

ctx.x: Jimmy Noonan, he was up there.

Well, by this time were you already, I mean, were you a musician or were you just- Well, I was caught in between three things. Be a ball player, study medicine, or be a musician. And the music went out. I used to like to play. When did you first start to study? Or play? Play, a professional job. I was around 14 years old. When were you born, Lindsey? Chicago. When? Nineteen-six. Nineteen-six. Oh. All you guys look so young, I don't know how you're doing, really. Well, you're taking yourself. Huh? You're taking…
But when it hit them, it hit them all at once. Yeah. It did. Change overnight. We'll see what happens.
